question: Will Mike Winkelmann (Beeple) post about $LAPTOP by September 30?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the specified person posts a qualifying textual reference to Hunter Biden's Laptop memecoin ($LAPTOP) on their accounts listed below between the creation of this market and September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The relevant accounts are:

Donald Trump:  X - @realDonaldTrump; Truth Social - @realDonaldTrump
Elon Musk: X - @elonmusk
Donald Trump Jr.: X - @DonaldJTrumpJr; Truth Social- @DonaldJTrumpJr
Eric Trump: X - @EricTrump; Truth Social - @EricTrump
Changpeng Zhao (CZ): X- @cz_binance
Mike Winkelmann (Beeple): X - @beeple

To qualify, a post's text must clearly refer to Hunter Biden's Laptop memecoin through language such as "Laptop Coin", "Laptop Token", "$Laptop", "Hunter Biden's New Coin", or an equivalently clear reference to the token. The word "laptop" alone, without context that clearly identifies the token, will not qualify. References solely to Hunter Biden's physical laptop, the Hunter Biden laptop controversy, its contents, related investigations, or any associated political events will not alone qualify.

For the purposes of this market, all text posted by such accounts in main feed posts, quote posts, and reply posts counts toward a "Yes" resolution, but text within quoted posts and reposts will not count.

Text posted in images, memes, or other non-animated, non-video media that are not strictly text will qualify toward a "Yes" resolution only if a qualifying reference appears in text within the content (e.g., "$LAPTOP" spelled out in a letter posted as a .jpg will qualify; a reference appearing only within an animated .gif or video will not). Words spoken aloud in videos, livestreams, or audio content will not count toward a "Yes" resolution; only posted text qualifies.

Posts published from an account during a period in which the account is verifiably compromised or hacked, as confirmed by the account owner or the platform, do not qualify.

The resolution source for this market will be X & Truth Social, specifically the account pages for the listed accounts.

question: LAPTOP airdrop by September 9?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if an airdrop of LAPTOP tokens is performed by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The token referenced in this market is LAPTOP, the token announced by Hunter Biden for launch on Base, as identified by the token's official channels (https://x.com/Laptoptoken) and confirmed by Hunter Biden or his official representatives.

An airdrop qualifies if LAPTOP tokens are distributed to, or made claimable by, eligible third-party wallets free of charge; a distribution limited to a specific community, such as holders of the TRUMP token, will qualify. Allocations to founders, team members, or other insiders will not qualify as an airdrop. For the purposes of this market, "locked" tokens or non-swappable tokens will not suffice to resolve this market to "Yes". Airdrops of NFTs or of tokens other than LAPTOP will not qualify.

The primary resolution source for this market is on-chain information and official information from Hunter Biden or the LAPTOP token's official channels, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.
